options.title: Closed on Shabbat — Settings
options.lede: The day-to-day settings live in the extension popup. This page holds only what does not fit there.
options.dismissedHint: Sites where you chose never to see the banner again. The toolbar badge still appears.
options.dismissedEmpty: You have not muted any site.
options.dataHint: The list ships with the extension and is updated with every release. Nothing is downloaded at runtime.
options.privacyBody: The extension collects nothing and makes no network request of its own. The site list is bundled into the extension itself, and every check runs on your own machine.
options.privacyForms: The one exception: when you click "Report a site" or "Appeal this listing", a Google Form opens in a new tab and the site's address travels to Google as part of the link. That happens only on your click.
options.privacyPermissions: Permissions are limited to the listed sites only — not to every site.
